app.name: Vista
app.pickCrewHint: Demo mode with sample jobs. The live app signs in with a code sent by text.
app.savedLocal: Saved on this phone. Syncs when you're back online.
today.title: Today
job.photosHint: No photos, no pay. The camera opens from Submit for pay.
job.notFound: That job isn't on this phone.
soon.title: Coming in the next step
soon.draw: Submit for pay: camera, photo manifest, and the SA_Expense__c write.
soon.approve: Approve: PMs review photos and approve or send back with a reason.
soon.vi: Ask Vi: answers in your language from the job record, the trade checklist and trade documents.
soon.problem: Report a problem: creates a Service Case with Work Type, Service Type and Warranty Type.
job.startFirst: Tap Start job when you arrive. Submit for pay opens once the visit is in progress.
job.notDispatched: This visit hasn't been dispatched yet. It will show up here once dispatch sends it.
approve.title: Approve pay
approve.queue: {n} pay requests waiting for your review
approve.cutoff: Submitted by 10:00 AM makes today's ACH run.
approve.smsTitle: Text to the installer at the 10:00 AM cutoff ({lang})
approve.doneApproved: Submitted as approved. It's on Angie's list for the next run.
approve.doneSentBack: Sent back. The installer sees it now and gets a text at cutoff.
review.noPhotos: No photos on this pay request.
review.photoNote: Tap a photo to enlarge. Photos load from storage once Salesforce is wired.
review.additional: Additional work documented with a note and photo
sms.sentBack: Vista: this pay request was not submitted for today's pay run. Job {wo} ({who}, {street}): {items}. Add it in Vista and your PM will review it for the next run.
job.markHint: Tick each line item as you finish it. It goes to Installation Completed in Salesforce.
job.markHintMeasure: Tick each line item once measured. It goes to Measurement Completed in Salesforce.
job.askForDraw: Need a draw before the job is done? Ask your PM directly.
draw.photosNeeded: No draw without progress photos: {n} of {need}. Ask the crew to add them in Vista.
draw.issue: Issue draw and submit to accounting
draw.issued: Draw submitted as approved. Mike Duncan has been notified.
draw.notEligible.notActive: Draws are issued while the visit is dispatched or in progress.
draw.notEligible.contract: This job is under the draw minimum.
draw.notEligible.trade: Draws aren't used for this trade.
draw.notEligible.nothingLeft: Nothing left on the contract to draw.
confirm.drawTitle: Are you sure you want to submit this draw?
confirm.payTitle: Are you sure you want to submit this pay request?
confirm.note: It goes to accounting as approved. It can't be changed from Vista after this.
confirm.drawNote: It goes to accounting as approved, before the job is complete. Mike Duncan is notified of every draw.
rollout.offTitle: Vista isn't on for your crew yet
rollout.offBody: Keep submitting pay the way you do today. Your PM will let you know when Vista is switched on.
txt.unknownNumber: This number isn't set up for Vista. Ask your PM to add it.
txt.off: Vista isn't on for your crew yet. Keep submitting pay the way you do today.
txt.none: No dispatched jobs right now. You'll get a text when dispatch sends one.
txt.listFootInstaller: Reply a number for details. START 1 · DONE 1 ALL · PAY 1 · HELP
txt.listFootMeasure: Reply a number for details. START 1 · DONE 1 ALL · FINISH 1 · HELP
txt.notFound: I couldn't find job {ref}. Reply TODAY for your list.
txt.started: Started job {wo}. Reply DONE {n} ALL as line items are finished, then PAY {n}.
txt.startedMeasure: Started measuring {wo}. Reply DONE {n} ALL when measured, then FINISH {n}.
txt.startFirst: Start the job first: reply START {n}.
txt.doneWhich: Which line items? Reply DONE {n} ALL, or DONE {n} 1 2.
txt.finishOpen: {left} line items still to measure. Reply DONE {n} ALL first.
txt.drawAsk: Draws are handled by your PM. Call or text {name}: {phone}.
txt.pay.amount: Submit for pay, job {wo}. How much? (up to {max})
txt.pay.amountOpen: Submit for pay, job {wo}. How much?
txt.pay.amountBad: Send an amount up to {max}, like 1400.
txt.pay.photo: Send {need}+ photo(s): {label}. Reply NEXT when done.
txt.pay.photoShort: Still need {more} more: {label}. No photos, no pay.
txt.pay.checklist: Did you finish all {n} checklist steps? Reply YES, STEPS to see them, or the numbers you skipped.
txt.pay.checklistShort: Noted. Your PM will see which steps were skipped.
txt.pay.itemsWarn: Your PM needs every line item installed for completion pay.
txt.pay.desc: Describe the work in one message.
txt.pay.sent: Sent to {pm} for review. You'll get a text when it's approved or if anything's missing.
txt.pay.resent: Resent to {pm} with the missing items.
txt.pay.pending: Job {wo} already has a pay request with your PM.
txt.photoNoFlow: Got the photo. To use it for pay, reply PAY and the job number first.
txt.help.installer: TODAY your jobs · 1 details · START 1 · DONE 1 ALL · PAY 1 · ENGLISH / ESPAÑOL / BILINGUAL · LANGUAGE to request another · APP / TEXT / BOTH to choose how we reach you. Any other question goes to Vi.
txt.help.measure: TODAY your jobs · 1 details · START 1 · DONE 1 ALL · FINISH 1 · ENGLISH / ESPAÑOL / BILINGUAL · LANGUAGE to request another · APP / TEXT / BOTH to choose how we reach you. Any other question goes to Vi.
txt.help.pm: TODAY pay to review · REVIEW 1 · APPROVE 1 · FIX 1 2 3 · DRAW 41859 3000 what it covers · ENGLISH / ESPAÑOL / BILINGUAL · APP / TEXT / BOTH. Any other question goes to Vi.
txt.lang: Got it, English from now on.
txt.channel.app: Got it: updates in the app only. Reply TEXT to get texts again.
txt.pm.blocked: Can't approve: lines {lines} are short. Reply FIX {n} {lines}.
txt.pm.replyYesPay: Reply YES to confirm all {k} deliverables and submit.
txt.pm.fixWhich: Which lines? Reply FIX {n} 1 2 (add BLURRY, WRONG or INCOMPLETE if needed).
txt.pm.drawUsage: Reply DRAW, the WO number, the amount and what it covers. Example: DRAW 41859 3000 front elevations
txt.pm.replyYesDraw: Reply YES to submit the draw.
txt.notice.approved: Vista: approved {amount} for job {wo}. It's on the next pay run.
txt.notice.sentBack: Vista: your PM sent back job {wo}. Needed: {items}. Reply PAY {ref} to fix it.
txt.notice.newReview: Vista: new pay request, {who} {amount} ({crew}). Reply REVIEW to see it.
txt.notice.dispatched: Vista: new job dispatched. {when} {who}, {street}. Reply TODAY for your list.
txt.viSoon: I'll be able to answer that once I'm connected. For now, call your PM.
lang.title: Language
lang.requested: Sent to Matt: {language}. Vi can already answer your questions in {language}.
txt.translated: Translated for you. Reply ORIGINAL {n} to see it as written.
txt.langBi: Got it: English and Spanish from now on.
txt.langOptions: Reply ENGLISH, ESPAÑOL or BILINGUAL. Need another language? Reply LANGUAGE and its name, like LANGUAGE Português.
txt.saveFailed: That didn't save. Try again, or call your PM.
txt.notice.stillWithPm: Vista: your pay request for job {wo} ({who}) is still with your PM. It will go in the next pay run once it's reviewed.
txt.notice.pmMissedCutoff: Vista: {n} pay requests missed today's 10:00 AM run. Reply REVIEW to see them.
txt.notice.heartbeatOk: Vista heartbeat recovered after failing at {step}.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.hint: Enter the mobile number on file with Southern Industries. We'll text you a 6-digit code.
signin.sent: If this number is on file, a code is on its way.
signin.bad: That code didn't work. Check the text and try again.
signin.offline: You're offline. Connect to sign in.
app.syncRefused: Vista couldn't save a change ({error}). Your screen was refreshed from Salesforce.
